titleZh: 疫情期間股東週年大會（AGM）｜2022
summaryZh: 於疫情期間協助客戶公司籌辦股東週年大會（AGM），統籌及執行現場安排，包括社交距離措施、場地人流管理及「安心出行」等防疫要求，在符合當時防疫規定的前提下，協助大會安全有序進行。
summaryEn: Supported the planning and execution of a client’s Annual General Meeting (AGM) during the COVID-19 pandemic, coordinating on-site arrangements including social distancing measures, crowd management, and LeaveHomeSafe requirements. Helped ensure the meeting was conducted safely and smoothly in accordance with the prevailing public health requirements.

summaryZh: 參與由多家中資機構共同支持的南丫島海岸清潔活動，與企業義工一同清理沿岸垃圾及廢棄物，以實際行動支持海洋環境保護，並提升社區對減廢及環境可持續發展的關注。
summaryEn: Participated in a coastal clean-up on Lamma Island alongside volunteers from various Chinese enterprises, helping remove litter and waste from the shoreline. The initiative supported marine conservation while promoting greater awareness of waste reduction and environmental sustainability.

titleZh: 咖啡渣再生 × 社區共融計劃
titleEn: Coffee Grounds Upcycling & Social Inclusion Initiative
summaryZh: 與一間致力推動共融就業、為 SEN 人士提供工作機會的 NGO 咖啡店合作，將日常營運產生的咖啡渣再生成植物培植土，搭配種子供顧客認領及栽種。透過連結綠色消費、資源循環與共融就業，讓環境可持續發展與社會價值融入日常生活。
summaryEn: Partnered with an NGO café dedicated to inclusive employment and providing job opportunities for individuals with special educational needs (SEN). Used coffee grounds from the café were repurposed into a growing medium and paired with seeds for customers to take home and grow, connecting green consumption and resource circularity with social inclusion.

titleZh: 長者社區膳食支援義工服務
titleEn: Community Meal Support for the Elderly
summaryZh: 於長沙灣參與非牟利機構的社區義工服務，協助為行動不便及日常煮食有困難的長者準備及派送膳食，為有需要的長者提供基本生活支援與關懷，以實際行動參與社區服務。
summaryEn: Volunteered with a non-profit organisation in Cheung Sha Wan to support elderly residents with limited mobility or difficulties preparing meals independently. Assisted with meal preparation and distribution, providing practical support and care to elderly members of the local community.

titleZh: 廢棄 Banner 升級再造計劃
summaryZh: 將廢棄宣傳 Banner 重新設計及升級再造成可重複使用的實用物品，延長物料生命週期並減少資源浪費。透過創意再生方式實踐循環經濟理念，將可持續發展融入日常營運及品牌實踐。
summaryEn: Repurposed discarded promotional banners into practical, reusable items, extending the lifecycle of materials and reducing waste. The initiative put circular economy principles into practice through creative upcycling, integrating sustainability into everyday operations and brand initiatives.

titleZh: 政府持份者項目匯報及交流｜2023
summaryZh: 組織及協調公司向渠務署等政府相關持份者進行現場項目匯報及交流，負責前期聯絡、匯報安排、現場協調及持份者溝通，協助公司展示項目進展及相關成果。
summaryEn: Organised and coordinated on-site project briefings and engagement sessions with the Drainage Services Department and other relevant government stakeholders. Responsibilities included pre-event liaison, presentation arrangements, on-site coordination, and stakeholder engagement, supporting the company in presenting project progress and key achievements.

titleZh: 客戶公司年度業績發布會｜2022
summaryZh: 協助客戶公司完成年度業績發布會的策劃與執行，負責媒體邀請及聯絡、管理層Q&A材料準備、活動流程統籌、現場協調及媒體溝通等工作。
summaryEn: Assisted in the planning and execution of the client’s annual results presentation, including media invitations and liaison, preparation of management Q&A materials, event coordination, on-site support, and media communications.

summaryZh: 陪同客戶公司出席《大公報》創刊120週年活動，協助處理現場對外聯絡及協調工作，包括安排客戶公司致賀花籃、現場溝通及相關公關事宜。
summaryEn: Accompanied the client company to Ta Kung Pao’s 120th Anniversary Celebration and assisted with external liaison and on-site coordination, including arranging congratulatory floral displays on behalf of the client, facilitating on-site communications, and handling related public relations matters.

summaryZh: 主導「2026秋季策略會」媒體邀約工作，成功邀請 16 家媒體共 17 位記者出席，吸引《大公報》、《明報》、《東方日報》及新浪財經（香港）等媒體報導，有效提升品牌聲量。
summaryEn: Led media outreach for the “2026 Autumn Strategy Conference,” successfully securing attendance from 17 journalists representing 16 media outlets. The event received coverage from leading media including Ta Kung Pao, Ming Pao, Oriental Daily News, and Sina Finance Hong Kong, effectively enhancing brand visibility and media exposure.
